question: Under what circumstance can the President of India dissolve the Lok Sabha before its normal term expires?

options.text: On the recommendation of the Prime Minister
Whenever the President wishes, without any conditions
After consulting a joint session of both Houses of Parliament
When the Supreme Court orders a dissolution

solution:
The correct answer is __**On the recommendation of the Prime Minister**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The President of India has the authority to dissolve the Lok Sabha before its normal term expires, but this action must be taken **on the advice of the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.**
